//rewrites: SPA fallback. Vercel resolves the filesystem BEFORE applying rewrites, so static files (/assets/*, /img/*, /sitemap.xml) are still served directly and only real routes such as /work/:slug fall through to the app shell. Do NOT try to exclude them with a regex lookahead here: `source` is a path-to-regexp pattern, not raw regex, and such a pattern silently matches nothing.
